name: Vaelastrasz the Corrupt
source: [logs: Season of Discovery] Melee 4,417 to 6,681 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 2.56 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 23 kills on Season of Discovery (Normal, 2025-02-05 to 2026-09-12): the median of 48 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (5,354), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (36 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 3,585 weapon damage, spread 0.631, a 2.13 s swing. Length: his longest stretch on one tank a kill, median 25 s (10th to 90th percentile 16 to 52). Weapon damage abilities: Cleave 19983 4,724 to 7,794 from 14 hits. Abilities: Burning Adrenaline 23620 on the tank every 45 s (it dies 20 s later), so tanks swap every 45 s. Flame Breath 23461 3,500 to 4,500 Fire every 5 to 10 s, frontal, and 938 to 1,062 Fire every 3 s for 15 s, stacking to 5. Cleave 19983 every 5 to 10 s. Fire Nova 23462 555 to 645 Fire to the raid every 2 s. The Classic Era client's spell data, timers from the vmangos script.

notes: One tank's stint (Burning Adrenaline comes every 45 s), so the fight is his longest stretch on one tank in the logs. Flame Breath's DoT stacks to 5 (client data), which a sim DoT can't, so each stack is its own 1,000 Fire every 3 s, the stacks coming one a breath (every 7.5 s from 11 s) and staying up. Fire resistance takes its share of the Fire. The Burning Adrenaline on casters and the raid's Fire Nova on others are the healing sim's.

healing.notes: From Season of Discovery's logs (23 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 3 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 3,293 a second with overheal and absorbs (51% of the heals effective), 2.70 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 1,972 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (4% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Paladin 9, Warrior 4, Warlock 4, Druid 3, Shaman 2, Rogue 1.

raidHealing.notes: What Season of Discovery raids had on Vaelastrasz the Corrupt (22 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 18 with 2 tanks (0 of them on adds, who took 0 a second together, not in the events), 4 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (78% of the healing), each 2,948 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 5,649 a second (2,081 on the tanks, 3,521 on the rest, 64% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 237.3 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.
